en: Black‑and‑white view of a large cobblestoned town square bordered by 3‑ to 4‑story historicist buildings with ornate facades. In the center of the square stand a column-like monument and a kiosk or pillar, with a few street lamps. Several horse-drawn carts and wagons are scattered around the empty square, with only a few pedestrians visible. Prominent signage on two buildings identifies them as hotels. The scene evokes a Central European town around the early 20th century.
